name: Café Ehaburu ~Black Version~
original_name: カフェ・エハーブル ～Black version～
source:
After competition the atmosphere in Café Ehaburu has changed. But protagonist likes old calm atmosphere of Ehaburu! He has to properly guide maids who start to act crazy.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-july-2007-bullet-butlers.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
比赛结束后，Ehaburu咖啡馆的气氛变了。但主人公喜欢的是过去那个平静安宁的Ehaburu！他必须好好管教那些行为开始失控的女仆。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-july-2007-bullet-butlers.html]vndbreview[/url]]
